errors.text_span: сортирани по низходящ ред според стойностите за 2023 г.
errors.evidence: The chart categories (vegetables) are sorted by their 2023 values in ascending order from top to bottom, not descending order.
The legend is located at the bottom center of the chart, not in the bottom left corner.

The description does not provide the numerical values for the highest and lowest bars as requested by the prompt. It mentions the categories (Potatoes, Garden pea) but omits their values (e.g., Potatoes 2023 is ~7000 ha, 2022 is ~9000 ha; Garden pea 2023 is ~600 ha, 2022 is ~800 ha).
The description uses the word 'височината' (height) to describe the dimension of the horizontal bars that represents value. The more accurate term would be 'дължината' (length).
